evals.prompt: 帮我先盘点美国 IKEA 沙发列表页的页面结构和可继续测试的交互点。不要点击、输入、展开、滚动或提交任何控件；只用页面刚加载后的可访问性快照。输出一份 page map，保存到本次运行指定的 outputs 目录，不要改动正式语料。URL：https://www.ikea.com/us/en/cat/sofas-sectionals-fu003/?filters=f-price-buckets%3APRICE_0_50000
evals.expected_output: One page-map record with page-evidence provenance and limits; visible controls are listed as candidates, no interaction response is claimed, and no repository files are changed.
expectations: Output contains exactly one record_type: page_map and evidence_class: page-evidence.
Does not claim a visible response for a control that was not operated; visible controls are listed as interaction candidates.
Records the requested public URL and states that no interaction was tested in limits.
No formal corpus or pattern files are changed.
The page-map `site` string exactly matches the canonical site name in corpus/ikea/site.md (`IKEA`); locale remains in page/context.
When browser capture succeeds, visible_structure and interaction_candidates contain concrete snapshot-based content rather than empty placeholders.
When the preferred browser surface fails and another supported surface is available, the run tries the fallback and records the actual tool and any isolation limitation.

evals.prompt: 审查候选“Zero-Count Facet Options Are Disabled”。读取它引用的观察和相关跨站模式，按独立站点分别列出直接支持、边界、反例，并判断是否达到晋升为 validated 的条件。只把分析报告保存到本次运行指定的 outputs 目录，不要改动正式语料，也不要把边界证据计作支持。
evals.expected_output: The candidate remains unvalidated because only IKEA directly observes disabled zero-count options; eBay, Amazon, and Airbnb are boundaries or adjacent evidence, not support or direct counterexamples. The report links its classification to the cited observation files and does not modify the repository.
expectations: Concludes status remains candidate because only one independent site directly demonstrates zero-count disabling.
Counts IKEA as the sole supporting site and keeps eBay, Amazon, and Airbnb as boundaries/adjacent evidence.
Does not treat adjacent cases or missing zero-count states as direct counterexamples.
Cites the candidate and supporting/boundary observation paths.
No formal candidate, pattern, or observation files are changed.

evals.prompt: 在 IKEA US 的公开沙发筛选页检查一次单独交互：如果初始页面存在可用的 Color → Red (1) 筛选项，就只选择一次它，记录动作前后结果数、筛选状态和可见响应。不要打开商品，不要测试其他控件，也不要改正式语料。若初始状态与描述不同或无法确认动作成功，就只记录实际观察到的结果和限制，不要推断。页面 URL：https://www.ikea.com/us/en/cat/sofas-sectionals-fu003/?filters=f-price-buckets%3APRICE_0_50000。将一条 UX-SPEC observation 及简短 Notes 保存到本次运行输出目录。
evals.expected_output: One observation record with canonical site name IKEA; one concrete action; directly observed before/after response and state; observed evidence with URL, date, tool, and reproduction; no interaction claims beyond the one selected facet; no formal corpus edits.
expectations: Observation `site` equals the corpus value `IKEA`; locale is recorded under page/context instead.
Trigger, action, response, and state describe exactly the one Red filter selection and its observed before/after state.
Evidence is `observed` and identifies the exact URL, date, tool, reproduction, before, and after.
No unsupported claims are made about product details, other controls, or unobserved effects.
No observation, candidate, pattern, or corpus record is changed.
